_about: Pindar in English, translator per title. Ernest Myers, The Extant Odes (1874), clean Gutenberg. Dawson W. Turner's literal prose (Bohn, 1852) with Abraham Moore's metrical version appended, raw IA OCR (1872 reprint, the cleaner scan). Moore's Olympic and Pythian odes also exist as a c1903 Boston reprint; not taken, it duplicates the Bohn appendix. Cary's Pindar (1833) is on lane C's cary shelf: cross-referenced, not fetched.
